Container.Name: Extrudo
Container.Overview:
Unofficial Unraid packaging of Extrudo, a free and open-source parametric CAD application for 3D printing.
Extrudo runs entirely in your browser. Designs are stored in that browser, not in an Unraid appdata volume, so export .extrudo backups regularly. Each hostname, protocol, port and browser has separate storage. HTTPS is recommended for full PWA, offline and browser-file functionality.
Container.Requires: A current desktop browser with WebGL2 and WebAssembly. HTTPS through a reverse proxy is recommended. Project data is browser-local and is not backed up by Unraid.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used to open Extrudo in your browser.
